cn_summary: DeepSeek在国庆假期前开源面向华为昇腾的基础设施组件（TileLang编译工具、高性能计算库、分布式通信库），与英伟达平台组件一一对应，性能接近硬件上限。梁文锋透露DeepSeek运营约2万块H系列算力芯片，估算训练顶级模型需5万颗GB300或20万颗昇腾950；昇腾推理芯片采购价为英伟达1/4，单卡算力比对华特供版提升2.87倍。据彭博报道，DeepSeek已向华为订购16万颗昇腾950DT用于内蒙古1GW数据中心。TileLang抽象层使模型代码可跨平台移植，DeepSeek并未与CUDA生态深度绑定。

title: Fewer Tokens, Better Action: GPT-6 Astra Robot Agents with 14% Higher Success Rate but 65% Fewer Tokens
raw_summary: Vision language model (VLM) agents can control robots through visual feedback and action primitives, but repeated model invocations and redundant observations incur substantial token overhead. We introduce PyRUA-Lean, an interactive code-execution framework that couples feedback-driven primitive composition with selective observation: the agent composes classical robot primitives and learned vision-language-action (VLA) policies into Python cells that perform conditional checks and local retries, returning only explicitly requested images and state feedback for replanning. Across 700 simulated task instances from LIBERO-PRO, RoboTwin 2.0, and RoboCasa365, we compare PyRUA-Lean with a tool-calling baseline using the same GPT-6 Astra planner and underlying robot primitives. Under equal LLM-call budgets, PyRUA-Lean increases overall success from 63.1% to 71.7%. On instances solved by both agents, it uses 49% fewer LLM calls and 65% fewer input tokens.
relevance_reason: GPT驱动的机器人Agent框架通过代码执行减少65% token消耗，间接影响推理算力效率与成本结构。
cn_summary: 研究提出PyRUA-Lean框架，面向基于GPT-6 Astra规划的VLM机器人Agent，通过代码执行+选择性观察减少冗余token。在LIBERO-PRO、RoboTwin 2.0、RoboCasa365共700个仿真任务中，等LLM调用预算下整体成功率从63.1%提升至71.7%；在双方都完成的子集上，LLM调用减少49%、输入token减少65%。值得关注的是该工作属于GPT-6相关规划器的Agent效率优化，体现前沿模型在机器人Agent场景的效率突破。
so_what: 跟踪点：1) OpenAI GPT-6发布节奏及在机器人Agent场景的部署进展；2) 推理效率提升对单位任务token消耗的影响，若大规模推广可能边际缓解算力需求增速；3) 与Anthropic、Google等竞品在Agent框架效率上的对比。
